jobs.title: Inspector - Civil - NDRC/Micro-tunneling
jobs.description: The Civil Inspector will be responsible for day-to-day supervision and inspection of stormwater drainage and microtunneling works. The role ensures all civil activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project standards while maintaining compliance with quality, safety, and authority requirements. Review and apply all applicable codes, standards, and project specifications related to stormwater and microtunneling works (e.g., pipelines, shafts, chambers, culverts, and outfalls). Conduct daily inspections to verify that all construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved shop drawings, method statements, and specifications. Monitor and inspect excavation, shoring, backfilling, microtunneling drives, shaft construction, reinforcement, concrete pouring, waterproofing, and finishing of stormwater structures. Verify alignment, gradients, and levels for stormwater pipelines, chambers, and manholes to ensure compliance with design. Ensure the Contractor’s works comply with Dubai Municipality (DM), RTA, and relevant authority standards and approved quality control procedures. Record and report daily manpower, equipment, and material deliveries on-site. Supervise the execution of concrete curing, coating, and lining works for stormwater-related structures. Assist the Resident Engineer (RE) and Assistant Resident Engineer (ARE) in issuing site instructions and verifying the contractor’s responses and close-out. Coordinate with the contractor to resolve civil works issues and follow up on corrective actions. Prepare daily inspection reports, including observations, progress updates, test results, and safety notes. Support surveying and measurement verification for pipe routes, invert levels, and structural tolerances. Monitor and support the testing, commissioning, and handover of stormwater networks and associated civil works. Assist in reviewing RFIs, method statements, and variance requests related to civil activities. Coordinate with client representatives and authority inspectors during inspections and document all findings. Maintain organized records of inspections, NCRs, test results, as-built updates, and executed works Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum 7 years of experience in construction supervision and inspection of NDRC, sewerage, drainage, and microtunneling infrastructure projects . Proven experience in microtunneling works , including launching/reception shafts, pipe jacking, tunneling operations, deep excavations, shoring systems, and associated underground utility works. Strong knowledge of inspection procedures for sewerage pipelines, manholes, chambers, reinforced concrete structures, and trenchless construction methodologies . Familiarity with Dubai Municipality (DM), RTA, DEWA , and other relevant UAE authority requirements and specifications.

jobs.description: The QA/QC Inspector (Rail) is responsible for carrying out site inspection and surveillance of civil works to verify compliance with approved designs, specifications and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Site Inspection & Surveillance Conduct daily inspections of civil works, including earthworks, concrete, structures, drainage and utilities. Carry out inspection and surveillance of civil works in accordance with approved Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), method statements and applicable hold/witness points. Verify materials and workmanship against approved drawings, specifications, project standards and applicable codes. Attend and witness testing activities (e.g., concrete cube testing, compaction/density testing, welding inspection) and verify results against acceptance criteria. Inspect earthworks (subgrade, embankment, compaction), concrete works (formwork, reinforcement, pours, curing), structures (bridges, culverts, retaining walls, buildings), drainage and utility works. Non-Conformances & Quality Records Raise and track non-conformance reports (NCRs) for work or materials that do not meet approved requirements, following through to close-out. Complete inspection checklists, daily quality reports and inspection request (IR) records for all inspected activities. Maintain accurate and complete quality records, photographs and supporting documentation for each inspection. Support the preparation of quality documentation and test/inspection packages for handover and close-out. Coordination & Compliance Liaise with contractor quality teams to coordinate inspection requests, hold/witness points and inspection scheduling. Coordinate with the design/engineering team on non-conformances, technical queries and any deviations requiring clarification or approval. Support internal and external quality audits and inspections, providing records and evidence as required. Report inspection findings, quality trends and recurring issues to the QA/QC Manager, escalating significant quality concerns promptly. Ensure compliance with the project Quality Management Plan, applicable codes/standards and contractual quality requirements at all times. Promote a quality-first culture on site and support contractor personnel in understanding and meeting quality requirements. Minimum Qualifications & Experience The following are the mandatory minimum requirements for this position: Minimum of five (5) years’ inspection or site supervision experience. Knowledge of construction quality procedures. Middle East / UAE experience is highly advantageous. Rail experience is preferable. University degree, or demonstrated equivalent experience in civil engineering / inspection.

jobs.title: Structural Engineer
jobs.description: The Structural Engineer will be responsible for supervising and inspecting structural works associated with stormwater, drainage, irrigation, pumping stations, utility structures, retaining structures, culverts, chambers, and other infrastructure assets. The role requires ensuring compliance with project specifications, authority requirements, quality standards, contractual obligations, and HSE regulations throughout the construction lifecycle. Supervise and inspect all structural construction activities related to stormwater, irrigation, drainage, pumping stations, culverts, manholes, chambers, utility structures, retaining walls, foundations, and associated infrastructure works. Ensure all structural works comply with project specifications, approved drawings, contract requirements, and the requirements of Dubai Municipality (DM), RTA, DEWA, and other relevant authorities . Review and provide comments on structural shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, temporary works, and as-built drawings. Verify that construction activities comply with applicable codes, standards, and engineering best practices. Coordinate with contractors, designers, utility authorities, and multidisciplinary teams to resolve structural design discrepancies, clashes, and site-related issues. Monitor contractor performance, construction sequencing, and progress to ensure works are completed in accordance with approved schedules. Direct, supervise, and coordinate the activities of structural inspectors and site supervision staff. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to verify workmanship, quality compliance, and adherence to approved construction procedures. Identify, document, and report non-conformances (NCRs) and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions. Ensure structural works interface effectively with roads, stormwater drainage networks, irrigation systems, utilities, and other infrastructure elements. Attend progress meetings, technical workshops, authority inspections, and coordination meetings to assist in resolving site and construction issues. Monitor testing activities related to structural works, including concrete works, reinforcement installation, structural elements, and material compliance. Assist the Senior Resident Engineer in reviewing contractor claims, variations, design changes, and technical submissions. Support snagging, project closeout, and handover activities, ensuring all structural works are completed and documented in accordance with project requirements. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports highlighting construction status, quality observations, risks, and recommendations. Monitor compliance with project HSE requirements and intervene when unsafe practices or work methods are observed. Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering with specialization in Structural Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 7  years of experience in construction supervision of infrastructure projects. Proven experience in stormwater, drainage, irrigation, utility, roads, and infrastructure projects . Strong knowledge of reinforced concrete structures, foundations, retaining walls, culverts, utility structures, and pumping station structures. Experience with QA/QC procedures, inspection processes, and contract compliance. Familiarity with UAE authority regulations and infrastructure project requirements. UAE/GCC experience preferred.

jobs.title: QA/QC Engineer - Infrastructure Projects
jobs.location: Al Ain, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: Job Summary The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for implementing and maintaining the Project Quality Management System to ensure that all infrastructure works comply with contract requirements, approved drawings, technical specifications, authority regulations, and applicable international standards. The role oversees quality assurance and quality control activities throughout the project lifecycle, from construction through testing & commissioning, handover, and project close-out. The QA/QC Engineer works closely with the Resident Engineer, Material Engineer, Contractors, Laboratories, Authorities, and Project Team to promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and compliance. Key Job Duties 1. Quality Management Implement and monitor the Project Quality Plan (PQP) and QA/QC procedures. Ensure construction activities comply with contract specifications, approved drawings, and quality standards. Monitor contractor compliance with approved Method Statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), and quality procedures. Conduct regular quality audits and site inspections. 2. Inspection & Testing Coordinate inspection activities and witness material and field testing. Review inspection requests, laboratory reports, and test results. Verify compliance of completed works prior to approval. Ensure proper documentation of all inspections and testing activities. 3. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions Review and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Site Observation Reports (SORs), and corrective action plans. Ensure timely implementation and close-out of corrective and preventive actions. Identify recurring quality issues and recommend improvement measures. 4. Material & Documentation Control Coordinate with the Material Engineer regarding material approvals and compliance. Review quality-related submittals, technical documents, and as-built records. Maintain quality registers, inspection records, and project documentation. 5. Stakeholder Coordination Liaise with the Client, Contractors, Authorities, and Testing Laboratories on quality-related matters. Participate in quality meetings, technical reviews, and project inspections. Support testing & commissioning and final handover activities. 6. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Prepare quality reports, KPI dashboards, and audit summaries. Monitor quality performance trends and recommend process improvements. Promote best practices and quality awareness across the project team Required Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline. Lead Auditor (ISO 9001) certification or equivalent quality management certification is preferred. Experience Minimum 10–15 years of QA/QC experience on major infrastructure projects. Proven experience in roads, utilities, drainage, sewerage, potable water, irrigation, public realm, and transportation projects. Strong experience in construction supervision and consultancy environments. Experience with UAE authority requirements and quality management procedures is highly desirable. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of QA/QC systems, ISO 9001, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and construction quality standards. Experience reviewing material approvals, laboratory testing, NCRs, SORs, and quality documentation. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, document management systems (e.g., Asite), and quality reporting tools. Good understanding of FIDIC contracts and construction supervision practices. Behavioural & Management Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination abilities. High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence. Ability to manage multiple quality activities under demanding project schedules. Professional, proactive, and committed to continuous improvement, compliance, and client satisfaction.

jobs.title: Survey and Track Inspector (Rail project)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Survey & Track Inspector carries out site survey and setting-out of civil works, and inspects and monitors permanent way and track works, on the PMEC High-Speed Rail Project, a double-track railway between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. The role checks that works are built in the correct position, alignment and level, in line with approved designs, specifications and tolerances. It also checks that track materials and workmanship meet the standards required for safe, reliable high-speed rail operation, from construction through to handover. Key Responsibilities Site Survey & Setting-Out (Civil Works) Conduct survey and setting-out of civil works, including earthworks, concrete, structures, drainage and utilities. Establish and verify survey control points, benchmarks and reference grids against approved drawings, design data and project coordinate systems and datums. Verify the alignment, levels and dimensions of constructed works against project standards and specifications. Carry out as-built surveys to confirm conformance with approved design and tolerances. Track & Permanent Way Inspection Inspect permanent way and track works, including rail, sleepers, fastenings, ballast or slab track, welding and track geometry. Verify track materials and workmanship against approved drawings, specifications, and project and track construction standards. Attend and witness track-related testing and measurement activities, such as track geometry checks, rail welding, and alignment and gauge checks, and verify results against acceptance criteria. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Support testing and commissioning activities related to survey and track works. Compile and verify handover documentation, including as-built survey records and track geometry records. Non-Conformances & Quality Records Raise and track non-conformance reports (NCRs) and corrective actions for survey or track work and materials that do not meet approved requirements, following them through to close-out. Complete survey and inspection checklists, field records and daily reports for all survey and inspection activities. Maintain accurate survey and quality records, including coordinate registers, photographs and supporting documentation. Coordination & Compliance Liaise with engineering, construction, and contractor survey, track/permanent way and QA/QC teams to coordinate setting-out, inspection requests and hold/witness points. Support internal and external audits related to survey and quality control. Ensure compliance with project specifications, the Quality Management Plan, and applicable civil, track and rail standards. Report survey and inspection findings and quality trends to the QA/QC Manager, escalating significant concerns promptly. Qualifications Essential Degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience in railway surveying or track inspection. Strong background in either railway surveying or track/permanent way inspection, with working knowledge of the other. Good knowledge of track geometry, alignment, construction quality procedures and survey/track inspection methods. Hands-on experience with surveying instruments such as total stations, GNSS, digital levels and track geometry trolleys. Ability to work accurately in a high-speed rail construction environment. Desirable Middle East or UAE project experience. High-speed or mainline rail project experience. Familiarity with Leica or Trimble equipment and survey/CAD software such as AutoCAD Civil 3D. Minimum of five (5) years' experience in survey, inspection or site supervision, [including at least 2–3 years on railway projects].

jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated Graduate Digital Solutions Specialist to join our Urbanism & Planning team. You will apply digital tools, spatial technologies, and data‑driven methods to real‑world urban planning and development projects. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you will support the integration of GIS, BIM, parametric modeling, and data analytics into project workflows, helping deliver innovative, sustainable, and future‑focused urban solutions. This role is a part of our 24-months Advance graduate program. Your journey from graduate to future leader will be supported through structured learning programs and one-on-one mentoring with industry experts, equipping you with the tools to make a lasting impact on our organization and the nation. As part of AECOM’s commitment to Emiratisation and in accordance with UAE labour law, only UAE Nationals with a family book will be considered for this role. Assist with collecting, organizing, and analyzing spatial and non‑spatial datasets to support planning and design decisions. Develop digital outputs including maps, dashboards, 3D models, and other visualizations used in project presentations and stakeholder communications. Work closely with planners, architects, engineers, and technical specialists to integrate digital capabilities into multidisciplinary project workflows. Provide junior‑level technical support for digital tools and help troubleshoot basic software issues. Participate in training, knowledge‑sharing, and continuous learning activities to build digital and urban planning capabilities. Stay informed about emerging digital tools and technologies relevant to urbanism, planning, sustainability, and smart cities.   UAE National with a Family Book (mandatory in line with Emiratisation and UAE labor requirements). Basic programming or data skills (e.g., Python, R, JavaScript) and exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) are an advantage. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with an interest in applying data‑driven and digital methods to urban planning challenges. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and readiness to grow in a fast‑paced digital planning environment.

Assess how delays on one contract affect the others and the overall programme completion date. Progress Monitoring and Verification Independently verify contractor-reported progress through site inspections, measurement records, design deliverable status and procurement tracking. Agree progress measurement methods and rules of credit with contractors and hold them to it. Track schedule performance using Earned Value Management (EVM), including SPI and CPI, earned value, planned value and forecast trends, and relate it to cost and payment performance. Reporting to the Client Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports and presentations for the client, summarising status, key issues, critical path movement, risks and recommended actions at an executive level. Produce programme dashboards, S-curves, milestone trackers and look-ahead summaries across all contracts. Present schedule findings in progress meetings and hold contractors to account for slippage and recovery commitments. Variance, Delay and Claims Assessment Identify and investigate schedule variances, determine root causes, and instruct or request recovery measures from contractors. Independently assess contractors' extension of time (EOT) claims and time impact analyses (TIAs), and prepare the Engineer's assessment. Assess the time effect of variations, instructions and change requests before they are issued, so the client understands the schedule consequences of its decisions. Keep independent schedule records to support the client's position in claims and disputes. Scope and Change Control Support scope control and change management across the programme, making sure approved changes are properly reflected in contractor programmes and the integrated master programme. Participate in the preparation, pricing, and negotiation of change orders with clients and contractors to ensure timely and accurate execution. Analyse tender returns and conduct market testing to support rate benchmarking and database updates. Maintain accurate records and documentation to support project reporting and decision-making. Eagerness to learn and develop within a structured training environment. Familiarity with quantity surveying software, BIM and other digital tools is essential. jobs.title: Planning Engineer
jobs.description: The Planning Engineer will be responsible for reviewing, monitoring, and reporting on the Contractor's planning and scheduling activities for major stormwater, drainage, irrigation, and associated infrastructure projects. The role requires close coordination with the Senior Resident Engineer, Contractor, and Project Team to ensure timely project delivery and effective management of programme risks. Key Responsibilities Review and analyze the Contractor's baseline programme, recovery programmes, and updated schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements. Monitor project progress against approved schedules and identify potential delays, risks, and mitigation measures. Evaluate construction sequencing, work logic, resource allocation, and critical path activities. Coordinate closely with Contractor planners and the supervision team to verify actual site progress. Conduct regular site visits to assess progress and validate programme updates. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, dashboards, critical path analyses, and schedule performance assessments. Track and report key project milestones, deliverables, and programme variances. Assist in evaluating Extension of Time (EOT) claims, variations, disruption claims, and recovery plans. Maintain accurate records of programme monitoring and support the assessment of contractual claims and change requests. Provide planning and scheduling support to the Senior Resident Engineer during project meetings, negotiations, and dispute resolution processes. Coordinate with contractors, utility authorities, and project stakeholders to ensure programme alignment and successful project delivery. Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline. Minimum 7  years of experience in planning and scheduling of infrastructure projects. Proven experience in stormwater drainage, irrigation, roads, utilities, or infrastructure projects . Proficient in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Strong understanding of CPM Scheduling, Critical Path Analysis, and Earned Value principles. Experience in contract administration and claims analysis is preferred. UAE/GCC experience is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Material Inspector
jobs.description: AECOM is seeking an experienced Materials Inspector for a major Roads and Infrastructure, NDRC, Stormwater, sewerange lines projects located in Dubai. The role involves both inspection and the supervision of Roads and Infrastructure works of the project and to ensure that the activities are being executed in accordance with the project specification. Inspect site conditions prior to the start of construction activities to verify the compatibility of the site with the approved design and permanent works. Check for obstructions and document existing site conditions through photographs to prevent potential damage to existing utilities, structures, and landscaping. Review and verify materials delivered to the site for conformance with approved samples, specifications, and equipment lists; report any non-conformances to the Resident Engineer (RE). Ensure that all materials are properly stored and protected at the site to maintain quality and prevent damage or contamination. Inspect construction of both temporary and permanent works to confirm compliance with contract documents, approved shop drawings, and project specifications. Prepare and maintain accurate daily inspection logs, test reports, and site records in accordance with the Contract Administration Procedures Manual. Monitor site safety practices and ensure that all works are carried out following approved safety procedures; report unsafe practices or incidents to the RE immediately. Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and Site Observation Reports (SORs) for any deviation from approved materials, specifications, or procedures, and follow up on corrective actions. Assist in the inspection of completed works, prepare punch lists, and monitor testing, commissioning, and handover activities to ensure quality compliance. Review and provide recommendations on Contractors’ Requests for Information (RFIs) related to civil materials and testing requirements. Evaluate requests for material variances or substitutions and provide technical comments and recommendations to the RE for approval. Read and interpret working drawings and related specifications, enforce compliance on-site, and prepare inspection and material testing reports. Coordinate with third-party testing laboratories and ensure all material tests are performed as per project specifications and standards. Ensure that all material approvals, test results, NCRs, and inspection records are properly documented and maintained for monthly reporting and project close-out. Coordinate with relevant authorities for material approvals, testing, and compliance verification. Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Relevant Technical Field 5 + years of relevant experience in laboratory materials testing including field inspection of samples and materials. Middle East experience preferred DCL  approval is preferred Relevant experience in comparable roads, NDRC, Stormwater, sewerage lines, pump station, irrigation works etc.

Support project closeout, final inspections, commissioning approvals, and handover of mechanical systems to the Client. Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 7  years of experience in construction supervision of infrastructure projects. Proven experience in stormwater, irrigation, pumping stations, water transmission, utility infrastructure, and associated mechanical systems . jobs.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor to manage project quantities, costs, contracts, and commercial activities. Roles & Responsibilities Prepare quantity take-offs, BOQs, cost estimates, and tender documents. Review drawings, specifications, and contract documents to determine quantities and costs. Monitor project costs, budgets, variations, and expenditures. Review contractor quotations, payment applications, and interim valuations. Assess variations, claims, and final accounts. Conduct site measurements and verify completed works. Prepare cost reports, forecasts, and commercial documentation. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and consultants. Good analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About The Team:

The Personalization team sits within Careem's Data Science organization and owns the AI systems that decide what every user sees, in what order, and why across Food, Quik, and Shops. Our mission is to build the hyper-personalization layer for the Careem app: real-time, cross-vertical recommendation and ranking systems that learn from a user's behavior in one vertical and apply that understanding everywhere else they engage with Careem. As one of the senior technical leads on this team, you'll help define how Careem thinks about personalization at a regional scale working alongside the region's top data science talent, and pushing the state of the art using graph-based retrieval, transformer architectures, and real-time learning.

What You'll Do:

  • Own hyper-personalization use cases across Food, Quik, and Shops designing systems that learn a user's intent and preferences in real time and transfer that signal across verticals, so a user's behavior on one product makes every other product smarter.
  • Be a technical lead on Careem's exploration of graph-based retrieval methods for recommendations including evaluating and building knowledge graph pipelines that power candidate generation and ranking at scale.
  • Design and evaluate transformer-based architectures (XFY) for sequential and contextual recommendation moving Careem's ranking and retrieval stack beyond classical ML toward deep, attention-based models.
  • Push toward online/streaming learning systems that adapt to user behavior within a session, not just from batch-trained models refreshed on a daily cadence.
  • Identify where personalization signals, models, or infrastructure can be shared across Food, Quik, and Shops rather than rebuilt per vertical reducing duplicate work and compounding the value of every experiment.
  • Be part of a 0-to-1 AI transformation for the Careem app from a personalization standpoint shaping how generative AI and LLM-based systems augment retrieval and ranking.
  • Build a long-term vision for how Careem rethinks customer acquisition and engagement strategies, grounded in data-driven decision-making.
  • Drive exploratory analysis to understand user behavior across verticals, identifying new levers to move metrics and building behavioral models that inform product enhancements.
  • Shape and influence the ML models and instrumentation that optimize the product experience, surfacing new areas of opportunity and new product directions.

jobs.title: Communications Manager – United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: Role summary The Communications Manager for the United Arab Emirates (UAE) supports the Public Affairs Officer of the UAE in enhancing and protecting the reputation of Citi in this key Middle East market. The Communications Manager for UAE will report to the Head of Communications for Middle East and Pakistan and be responsible for supporting the development and execution of proactive external and internal communications for Citi in the UAE. From time to time, the Communications Manager will also support communications programs in other Middle East markets. The role will involve executing communications to enhance and protect the reputation of Citi, its businesses and the brand in the market through communication with Citi's various stakeholders, external and internal. The role will also work with various teams across the organisation globally. External Communications: Developing, leading and executing on external communications strategy and plans for Citi in the UAE; Managing proactive engagement with key media outlets across the UAE and region-wide; Developing messaging, briefing documents and speaking notes for senior executives; Amplifying brand activities and events in the external market; Identifying opportunities and continuously building a strong pipeline of media and social media activity, organising and managing speaking opportunities; Supporting evaluation and metrics related to Citi’s communications in the market. Internal Communications and Engagement: Developing and executing internal engagement plans and initiatives; Planning and managing internal communications channels and content; Planning and managing employee engagement events; developing content for events. Evaluation and implementation of internal communications metrics. Reputation risk assessment, crisis and issues management: Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency. Volunteerism: Development and execution of plans to support volunteering activities and other initiatives related to Citi’s partnerships and relationships with NGOs. Skills and Attributes There is a strong focus on stakeholder engagement that requires being comfortable working with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders. 8 - 10 years of professional experience in Communications and Public Relations, either in-house or agency preferred Comprehensive understanding and a proven track record in media relations and stakeholder engagement. A team player with strong leadership qualities, excellent planning and project skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and adjust priorities as needed Excellent communications skills -editing, writing and digital communications skills. Experience in content creation for internal and external purposes Social media content development experience and working knowledge of major social media platforms Creativity and an ability to show initiative; strong relationship management skills, ability to lead and influence at a senior level Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business management, communications, marketing or related field Language skills: Fluency in English is required. jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description: Maintenance Specialist Are you a hands-on technical professional passionate about maintaining high-performance equipment and ensuring operational readiness? Join our Maintenance & Workshop Team! Our Maintenance team plays a vital role in supporting service delivery by ensuring wireline tools and equipment are maintained to the highest standards. We enable operational excellence by performing preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting complex systems, and ensuring assets are ready for deployment. We partner closely with field operations and engineering teams to deliver reliable equipment that meets customer and business needs. Partner with the best We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Specialist to execute maintenance, repair, and testing of wireline tools and equipment. You will be responsible for ensuring equipment performance, safety, and compliance while supporting service delivery teams with asset readiness. As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be responsible for: Performing inspection, testing, cleaning, and repair of wireline tools and equipment. Conducting assembly/disassembly and system-level validation of downhole and surface equipment. Executing preventive and corrective maintenance, fault finding, and functional testing. Managing incoming inspection and post-job evaluation of equipment. Ensuring equipment preservation, storage readiness, and accurate documentation of maintenance history. Supporting work preparation, including spare parts planning and repair scope definition. Participating in root cause analysis and failure investigations. Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workshop environment. Following HSE policies, maintenance procedures, and quality standards. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will: Hold a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or Mechanical Engineering. Have experience in maintenance, repair, and testing of wireline tools and equipment. Possess strong expertise in electro-mechanical and electronic systems, with experience in Sondex tools or similar wireline product lines highly preferred. Demonstrate proficiency in troubleshooting circuits, sensors, telemetry, mechanical, and hydraulic systems. Be experienced in SAP or similar maintenance management systems. Be skilled in reading schematics, circuit diagrams, and mechanical drawings. Exhibit strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. Be a collaborative team player with strong coordination skills across field and operations teams. Should be willing to travel internatioally Work in a way that works for you We value flexibility and are committed to providing working arrangements that help you perform at your best. Working with us At Baker Hughes, our people are at the heart of what we do. We foster an inclusive environment where employees are empowered to grow, innovate, and bring their authentic selves to work. Working for you Our innovations have shaped the energy industry for over a century. We value your contributions and offer: Flexible work-life balance policies Comprehensive medical and insurance coverage Life and disability benefits Financial and retirement programs Additional voluntary benefits The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Manufacturing Professional - Equipment Maintenance

jobs.title: Stakeholder Manager (Rail)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Stakeholder Manager leads all stakeholder identification, engagement and interface activities across the design and construction of a major rail project. The role protects programme and reputation by securing timely approvals, NOCs and third-party agreements. It also builds constructive relationships with authorities, utility owners, communities and other key parties, and resolves issues before they affect delivery. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement and maintain the Stakeholder Management Plan and Stakeholder Register, including stakeholder mapping, influence/interest analysis and engagement strategies for each project phase. Act as the primary point of contact for government authorities, regulators, municipalities, transport authorities, utility providers, developers and third-party asset owners. Lead the process for obtaining permits, approvals, NOCs and third-party agreements in coordination with design, construction and planning teams, and track status against the programme. Manage interfaces with adjacent projects, operators and asset owners, including interface registers, agreements and regular coordination meetings. Plan and deliver community and public engagement activities, including consultations, notifications of works, traffic diversions and disruption mitigation. Establish and oversee the enquiries and complaints management process, making sure issues are logged, investigated and closed out within agreed timeframes. Identify stakeholder-related risks and constraints early, escalate as needed, and develop mitigation strategies with the project leadership team. Work closely with Design, Construction, Planning, HSE, Legal and Communications teams so that stakeholder commitments are captured and delivered. Prepare stakeholder reports, briefing notes and presentations for the Client, senior management and external bodies. Make sure all engagement complies with contractual requirements, local regulations and client standards. Lead, mentor and develop the stakeholder and interface management team, delegating and evaluating work assignments. Minimum Requirements At least 15 years' experience in the management of design and/or construction of rail projects and in stakeholder management. At least 5 years' experience in the management of design and/or construction of a railway project. Has held the same position (Stakeholder Manager or equivalent) on at least one project of similar size and complexity. High-Speed Rail (HSR) experience is highly preferred  Middle East and UAE experience is highly advantageous Local experience  is preferred Skills and Competencies Strong understanding of UAE authority approval processes and the regulatory environment for major infrastructure. Excellent negotiation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills at senior government and client levels. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Ability to translate technical rail design and construction issues for non-technical audiences. Sound judgement, political awareness and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion. Proficiency with stakeholder management and reporting tools and MS Office. University degree in Engineering or a related discipline; a Master's degree and/or Chartered Engineer (CEng) status is preferred.

jobs.title: Manager - Planning
jobs.description: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Planning Manager to lead schedule and cost controls across complex infrastructure and buildings programs. You will shape robust baselines, drive project performance, and provide clear insights that help our clients make confident decisions. Lead all planning, scheduling, and project controls activities for major building and infrastructure projects. Develop, review, and manage baseline, revised, recovery, and resource-loaded schedules. Monitor project progress, critical path activities, and key contractual milestones. Evaluate and manage EOT submissions, delay analyses, and Time Impact Assessments (TIA). Review contractor programs and ensure compliance with contractual requirements. Provide strategic planning advice to Project Directors and senior management. Lead planning meetings and present project performance reports to clients and stakeholders. Develop mitigation and recovery plans to address project delays. Oversee project controls reporting, forecasting, and schedule risk management. Mentor and manage planning engineers and project controls staff. jobs.title: Senior BIM Technician
jobs.description: Produce the most demanding models and drawing packages in a project team and work without close supervision. Key responsibilities Model and drawing production Deliver models and drawings for the team's scope, including complex gravity and pressure networks, corridors, surfaces and cross sections. Apply NOC data standardisation and base plan standardisation to the work. Maintain base plan and title block requirements at each milestone stage. Proven Civil 3D production work on live infrastructure projects, not training exercises. Middle East experience preferred. Technical requirements Civil 3D to an advanced level: pipe and pressure networks, corridors, surfaces, data shortcuts, styles, label sets and sheet sets. AutoCAD and Navisworks for clash review. jobs.title: BIM Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Summary Supervising a group of BIM team leads to delivering concurrent infrastructure projects and carrying accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review. Key responsibilities Deployment and progress Own the deployment of resources across the group's disciplines and rebalance it as project demand moves. Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group. Own the key performance indicators reported for the group and the progress position on clash and issue resolution. Onboard third parties were brought in to support the project team. Delivery management Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans. Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files. Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project. Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams. Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings. Validation and issue Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist. Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check. Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review. Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities. Clash and Interface Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end. Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision. Agree with the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix. Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated. Deliver internal training on the authoring tools and confirm the group's capability against project requirements. Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role. Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.   Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience. 10+ years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy. Demonstrable record of delivering to ISO 19650 on live projects; formal certification is an advantage. Middle East consultancy experience is strongly preferred. Fluent written and spoken English. Technical requirements Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management. Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing. ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need. Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others. Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

jobs.title: Land Surveyor (Roads, Bridges and Infrastructure)
jobs.description: The Land Surveyor will be responsible for performing precise surveying and setting-out activities for stormwater and microtunneling works, including shafts, tunnels, pipelines, chambers, and related structures. The role ensures that all construction alignments, levels, and coordinates are established accurately and in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, and RTA/DM standards. Perform topographic, control, and setting-out surveys for stormwater and microtunneling works, including pipelines, shafts, manholes, and associated civil structures. Establish, verify, and maintain survey control points, benchmarks, and reference grids in coordination with the contractor’s survey team. Review and apply approved IFC drawings, alignment data, and coordinate systems in compliance with RTA and project requirements. Check and verify horizontal and vertical alignments, pipe inverts, tunnel drives, and shaft locations prior to and during construction. Ensure that all setting-out activities are carried out in accordance with approved method statements and calibration procedures. Conduct as-built surveys and verify the accuracy of contractors’ as-built drawings prior to submission. Monitor microtunneling drive alignments and breakthrough coordinates, ensuring compliance with allowable tolerances. Maintain up-to-date survey records, field books, and digital data files, ensuring full traceability of survey operations. Coordinate with the contractor and supervision team to resolve survey discrepancies or deviations on-site. Verify and certify survey results for measurement sheets, interim payments, and progress verification. Participate in pre-construction and progress meetings to provide input on survey status, site constraints, and required actions. Ensure full compliance with HSE standards during all field operations, particularly in confined-space and shaft areas. Calibrate and maintain survey instruments (total stations, GPS, digital levels) in accordance with project QA/QC procedures. Provide support during testing, commissioning, and handover stages by verifying final levels and coordinates. Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related discipline. RTA approval and certification for Microtunneling Works is mandatory. Certification in surveying instruments and data management is an advantage. Proficient in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GPS, Total Station, and surveying software. Familiar with RTA, DM, and DEWA standards for utility and infrastructure projects.

Develop and maintain the civil works construction programme for depot and online buildings, monitoring progress, identifying delays and implementing recovery measures. Manage cost control, change/variation assessment and reporting for the civil works package(s) under their responsibility. Enforce project health, safety and environmental (HSE) requirements across all depot and online building work sites. Manage technical and programme interfaces with systems-wide contractors (rolling stock, signalling, power, telecommunications, permanent way) and with the client, engineer and relevant authorities (municipalities, utility providers, civil defence). We're looking for a Senior Operations Associate - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. What you'll need

  • 1-3 years in operations, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics, or retail/e-commerce marketplace roles, with at least 2 years managing teams and external partners directly.

  • Must be fluent in English; Arabic fluency is preferred

Proactive, organized, and committed to quality, safety, and timely project delivery.
